title: HYB服务器
description:
这是一个由xingmangoffical运营的公益服务器
This is a public welfare server operated by xingmangoffical
body:
汉语:这是一个我的世界公益服务器，其不受费用，国外友人也可低延迟进入的mc的java1.21.8的leaves服务器，可以生电，交友，聊天，服务器有QQ群交流问题，服主节假日也会24小时回答问题，且包含core回档插件，和dom领地插件，有效防止了熊孩子偷家，还有sit等动作插件，包括leaves自带的假人，我们欢迎所有人的进入
English:This is a Minecraft charity server of MineCraft (My World), which is free to play and allows international friends to connect with low latency. It is a Leaves server running Minecraft Java 1.21.8, where players can generate power, make friends, and chat. The server has a QQ group for discussions and troubleshooting, and the server owner answers questions 24/7 during holidays. It also includes the Core rollback plugin and the Dom territory plugin, effectively preventing mischievous kids from stealing houses, as well as action plugins like Sit, and even comes with the Leaves built-in NPCs. We welcome everyone to join.
